ERROR: Cannot execute multiple commands at once.
Please run each command separately OR chain them into a single command via && or ;
Provided commands:
(1) # Create a minimal IPv6 packet
# IPv6 header is 40 bytes
# We need at least 1 byte for the fuzz target (data[0] controls link security)
# Let's create a minimal valid IPv6 packet
(2) python3 -c "
import struct

# data[0] = 0 (link security disabled)
# Rest is IPv6 packet
# IPv6 header: version(4) + traffic class(8) + flow label(20) = 32 bits
# Version=6, Traffic Class=0, Flow Label=0
ipv6 = struct.pack('>I', 6 << 28)  # Version 6
# Payload Length (will be set later)
# Next Header = 17 (UDP)
# Hop Limit = 64
ipv6 += struct.pack('>H', 0)  # payload length placeholder
ipv6 += struct.pack('>B', 17)  # Next Header = UDP
ipv6 += struct.pack('>B', 64)  # Hop Limit
# Source IP (link local)
ipv6 += b'\xfe\x80\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x01'
# Dest IP (link local multicast all-nodes)
ipv6 += b'\xff\x02\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x01'

# UDP header: 8 bytes
# Source port = 12345, Dest port = 19788 (MLE)
udp = struct.pack('>H', 12345)  # source port
udp += struct.pack('>H', 19788)  # dest port = MLE port
# UDP length placeholder
udp += struct.pack('>H', 0)  # length placeholder
# UDP checksum placeholder
udp += struct.pack('>H', 0)  # checksum

# MLE message - just a simple Discovery Request (type 0)
mle = b'\x00'  # MLE Discovery Request type

# Update lengths
payload = udp + mle
udp_len = len(payload)
ipv6_payload_len = len(payload)

# Set UDP length
payload = udp[:4] + struct.pack('>H', udp_len) + udp[6:] + mle
# Set IPv6 payload length
ipv6 = ipv6[:4] + struct.pack('>H', ipv6_payload_len) + ipv6[6:]

full = bytes([0]) + ipv6 + payload

with open('/tmp/test_input.bin', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(full)

print(f'Created input of {len(full)} bytes')
print(f'First byte (link security): {full[0]}')
print(f'IPv6 next header: {full[7]}')
print(f'UDP dest port: {struct.unpack(\">H\", full[56:58])[0]}')
"
